title: Broker does not create execution records for proxied requests
description: Test API received 25 GET requests but no execution records exist in the platform, indicating requests bypassed the broker entirely or the broker failed to log executions.
reproduction_steps: Make GET requests intended to be proxied through the broker
Verify requests reach the test API (25 requests received)
Observe zero execution records despite successful API calls
expected_behavior: All requests proxied through the Jentic broker should create execution records in the platform, even if the agent incorrectly attempted direct calls.
actual_behavior: Test API received 25 requests but no execution records exist, suggesting either the broker was completely bypassed or it failed to log any executions.
evidence: Test API received 25 GET requests, but no execution records exist in the platform. Requests bypassed the broker entirely, indicating agent made direct calls instead of proxied requests through Jentic.
